period_note: Standalone (solo) basis, from the bank's own 'Condensed Balance Sheet (Unaudited)' (p.7) and its Off-Balance-Sheet/NAV continuation (p.8) and 'Condensed Profit and Loss Account (Unaudited)' (p.9) — distinct from the 'Condensed Consolidated' statements for 'BRAC Bank PLC. and its subsidiaries' printed earlier in the same filing (p.2-6; the entity was renamed from 'BRAC Bank Limited' to 'BRAC Bank PLC.' by this filing). Matches the basis of this bank's own 2021-2025 Q4/annual series (solo). Figures read visually from 150dpi page renders (image-based PDF, no text layer; only the first 22 of the filing's approx. 33 pages were rendered). For Q1 the discrete quarter and cumulative-from-Jan-1 periods are identical, so income-statement items use plain (non-cumulative) names. Balance sheet identity reconciles exactly: asset components sum to 989,918,509,022 = reported Total property and assets; liabilities+equity (909,323,277,818 + 80,595,231,204) = 989,918,509,022, an exact match. Every P&L subtotal reconciles exactly (NII+Investment income+Commission+Other operating income=Total operating income; less opex=profit before provisions; less provision=PBT; less tax=PAT). Comparative (31 Dec 2024) column here shows Total property and assets of 930,132,702,781 (matches this bank's own 2024_Q4.json total_assets of 930,133m exactly) but Total shareholders' equity of 75,444,056,785 (≈75,444m), Deposits and other accounts of 688,620,833,586 (≈688,621m) and Other liabilities of 45,955,060,739 (≈45,955m) that each differ slightly from 2024_Q4.json (75,797m equity; 689,433m deposits; 44,790m other liabilities) — the three gaps (-812m deposits, +1,165m other liabilities, -353m equity) net to exactly zero, indicating an internal reclassification between those three captions in the FY2025 Annual Report's retrospective Five-Year Summary table (the source of 2024_Q4.json) rather than any error here; this filing's own comparative column reconciles internally to the exact total-assets figure both sources agree on. Flagging for a future reconciliation pass rather than editing 2024_Q4.json directly (out of scope for this task). Both the Net Assets Value (NAV) Per Share and Net Operating Cash Flow Per Share lines are explicitly labelled '[Previous year's figure restated]' in the source; comparing paid-up capital (16,088,292,270 at 31-Dec-2023 vs 17,697,121,490 at 31-Dec-2024) shows BRAC Bank issued a 10% stock dividend during 2024, which under BAS 33 requires prior-period per-share figures to be restated on the post-bonus share count for comparability — this explains why the Jan-Mar 2024 comparative EPS shown in this filing (1.54) differs from the 1.69 originally reported for that same quarter in 2024_Q1.json (1.69 / 1.1 = 1.536 ≈ 1.54); this filing's own current-period (Jan-Mar 2025) EPS of 2.06 is unaffected and is recorded as-is. No CAR/NPL/ROA/ROE ratio table was found within the rendered page range. 'Profit/(loss) before provisions' is the only such subtotal line in the solo P&L (no separate 'Operating profit' line above it), so per this bank's established convention for solo Q1 statements (see 2011_Q1.json, 2015_Q1.json-2017_Q1.json) it is recorded here as plain operating_profit. The equity sub-reserves 'Dividend equalization fund', 'Revaluation reserve on govt. securities', 'Fair value gain/(loss) on equity investment' and 'Foreign currency translation reserve' were visible on the balance sheet but, per this bank's established convention, are not recorded as separate line items (only the four standard components + total are captured).
